question: List items after a Layouts pick: their tag, margins and marker (bullet or number), for Heading 1 to 4 items; read twice.
how: f86 on the oracle, Blocks Probe at 1600 by 1000, nothing saved, each run on a new blank section and left by Exit and Exit Without Saving. Texts added from the menu and filled by a paste event (no clipboard); one real press on the Text first line (a caret move) so Escape reaches it; the section hovered, the layout switcher and the tile pressed by a real pointer with an on-top check. Then each list item read: tag, box, margins, the computed ::before of its child and where its text starts. Runs: A a 2-item bullet list alone, layouts 4 then 2; B a 2-item numbered list alone, layout 4; C a bullet list Text with a paragraph Text, layouts 0, 1, 2; D a heading Text with a bullet list Text, layouts 2 and 4. Each run read in two separate passes (a and b); every value read the same in both.
unnamedPresses: One press on each Text first line, 30 in and 10 down, to put the key focus in the frame (no typing)
facts: A heading in a list item has margins of half its own size, above and below: Heading 1 66.4px with 33.2, Heading 2 58 with 29, Heading 3 41.2 with 20.6, Heading 4 26.08 with 13.04. A paragraph item keeps 8 at 16px.

Each item child draws the paragraph marker at its own size: a bullet is "•" in an inline-block at least 40px wide, 40px to the left, 10px of right padding, set right, in the text colour (black here). A number is two spaces, the count and ". ", the same box with no padding; at Heading 1 it is 89.2 wide, so the centred line moves 24.6 right (text at 697 against 672.4 for a bullet).

Run C: the list Text takes the heading place; layout 0 gives Heading 3 items (centred), layout 1 Heading 2, layout 2 Heading 1. Run D: the list Text is the paragraph; layouts 2 and 4 give Heading 4 items.
